report--verb.def: To tell the authorities or the public about something.
report--verb.ex: She reported the theft to the police.

chief--adj.def: Most important, or highest in rank.
chief--adj.ex: Cost was the chief reason for the delay.

general--adj.def: Concerning the whole of something rather than the details.
general--adj.ex: He gave us a general idea of the plan.
general--adj.exTr: Bize planın genel bir fikrini verdi.

general--noun.def: An officer of the highest rank in an army.

pain--noun.def: The feeling you have when part of your body hurts.
pain--noun.ex: She felt a sharp pain in her knee.

wake--verb.def: To stop sleeping, or to make someone stop sleeping.
wake--verb.ex: I woke at six this morning.

kiss--verb.def: To touch someone with your lips to show love.

ship--verb.def: To send goods to a customer or another place.

suppose--verb.def: To think that something is probably true.
suppose--verb.ex: I suppose she is still at work.

completely--adv.def: In every way, with nothing left out.
completely--adv.ex: The old bridge was completely rebuilt.

totally--adv.def: Entirely, in an informal and emphatic way.

forgive--verb.def: To stop being angry with someone for a fault.
forgive--verb.ex: She forgave him after a long talk.
forgive--verb.exTr: Uzun bir konuşmadan sonra onu affetti.

definitely--adv.ex: I will definitely be there by noon.

security--noun.def: Protection from danger, or the people who provide it.
security--noun.exTr: Havaalanı güvenliği her çantayı kontrol etti.

film--verb.def: To record moving pictures with a camera.

round--adj.def: Shaped like a circle or a ball.
round--adj.ex: We sat at a round table.

round--noun.def: One stage of a competition or a series of events.
round--noun.ex: Our team lost in the second round.

near--adj.def: Only a short distance or a short time away.
near--adj.ex: The nearest station is on this street.

near--adv.def: At a short distance from a place.

entire--adj.ex: He spent the entire day reading.

handle--verb.def: To deal with a person or a situation successfully.
handle--verb.ex: She handled the complaint very calmly.
handle--verb.exTr: Şikâyeti çok sakin bir şekilde ele aldı.

buddy--noun.def: An informal American word for a close friend.
buddy--noun.ex: He went fishing with an old buddy.

paid--adj.def: Given money for the work, or already settled.
paid--adj.ex: She has four weeks of paid leave.

protect--verb.def: To keep someone or something safe from harm.

swear--verb.def: To promise very seriously, or to use rude words.
swear--verb.ex: He swore that he had told the truth.

bill--verb.def: To send someone a request for payment.
bill--verb.ex: The garage billed us for two hours.
bill--verb.exTr: Tamirhane bize iki saatlik fatura kesti.

army--noun.def: The part of a country's forces that fights on land.
army--noun.ex: His brother joined the army last year.

lead--adj.def: Most important, or in the main position.

lead--verb.def: To guide a group, or to go in front of others.
lead--verb.ex: This path leads to the lake.

fair--noun.def: An event where companies show or sell their products.
fair--noun.ex: We met at a book fair.

fool--verb.def: To trick someone into believing something untrue.
fool--verb.ex: Don't let the low price fool you.

group--verb.def: To put people or things together in sets.

single--noun.def: A room for one person, or a short music release.
single--noun.ex: I booked a single for two nights.
single--noun.exTr: İki geceliğine tek kişilik oda ayırttım.

marriage--noun.def: The legal relationship between two people who marry.

present--adj.def: Existing now, or being in a particular place.
present--adj.ex: All the students were present today.

count--noun.def: The act of counting, or the total you reach.
count--noun.ex: The final count was two hundred.

charge--noun.def: The price asked for something, or a formal accusation.
charge--noun.ex: There is no charge for delivery.

charge--verb.def: To ask a price, or to put power into a battery.

surprise--verb.def: To make someone feel something unexpected has happened.

bar--verb.def: To stop someone from entering or from taking part.
bar--verb.ex: He was barred from the club.

fish--verb.ex: They fish in the river every summer.

star--verb.def: To play the main part in a film or a play.
star--verb.ex: She starred in three films last year.
star--verb.exTr: Geçen yıl üç filmde başrol oynadı.

detective--noun.def: A police officer or private agent who investigates crimes.

prison--noun.def: A building where criminals are kept as punishment.
prison--noun.ex: He spent three years in prison.

stick--verb.def: To fix one thing to another, or to become unable to move.
stick--verb.ex: Stick the stamp in the corner.

record--noun.def: Written information kept for later, or a best performance.
record--noun.ex: The school keeps a record of absences.

public--adj.def: Open to everyone, or belonging to the government.

fix--verb.def: To repair something, or to fasten it firmly.
fix--verb.ex: Can you fix the broken chair?

proud--adj.def: Pleased about something good you or others have done.
proud--adj.ex: Her parents are very proud of her.

service--noun.def: Work done for customers, or a system that helps the public.
service--noun.ex: The service in that restaurant is slow.

service--verb.def: To check a machine and repair it if needed.
service--verb.ex: The car is serviced once a year.

soul--noun.def: The part of a person that many believe never dies.
soul--noun.ex: The old song touched his soul.

killing--noun.def: The act of causing a person or animal to die.
killing--noun.ex: The killing shocked the small town.

respect--noun.def: A good opinion of someone because of their qualities.
respect--noun.ex: He earned the respect of his team.

respect--verb.def: To admire someone, or to accept their rights.

mess--noun.def: A dirty or untidy state, or a confused situation.
mess--noun.ex: The kitchen was a complete mess.

cell--noun.def: A small room in a prison, or the smallest unit of life.
cell--noun.ex: The prisoner sat alone in his cell.

drunk--adj.def: Unable to behave normally because of alcohol.
drunk--adj.ex: He was too drunk to drive.

laugh--noun.def: The sound you make when something is funny.
laugh--noun.ex: She has a loud, warm laugh.
laugh--noun.exTr: Gür ve sıcak bir gülüşü var.

smell--verb.def: To have a particular odour, or to notice one.
smell--verb.ex: The kitchen smells of fresh bread.

honest--adj.def: Telling the truth and not cheating people.

judge--noun.def: The official who decides cases in a court.
judge--noun.ex: The judge listened to both sides.

dare--verb.def: To be brave enough to do something risky.
dare--verb.ex: Nobody dared to ask the question.

relationship--noun.def: The way two people or things are connected.
relationship--noun.ex: They have a close working relationship.

prove--verb.def: To show with evidence that something is true.
prove--verb.ex: The photo proved he was there.

involved--adj.def: Taking part in something, or connected with it.
involved--adj.ex: Three schools were involved in the project.

obviously--adv.def: In a way that is easy to see or understand.

professor--noun.def: A teacher of the highest rank at a university.
professor--noun.ex: The professor published a new book.

joke--verb.def: To say funny things that you do not mean seriously.
joke--verb.ex: He joked about his own cooking.

huge--adj.def: Extremely large in size or amount.
huge--adj.ex: They live in a huge old house.

holy--adj.def: Connected with God or religion, and deeply respected.

jail--noun.def: A place where people are locked up by the law.
jail--noun.ex: He was sent to jail for fraud.

shop--verb.def: To go to stores in order to buy things.
shop--verb.ex: We shop at the market on Sundays.

decision--noun.def: A choice you make after thinking about it.

slow--adv.def: At a low speed, used informally.

slow--verb.def: To move more slowly, or to make something do so.
slow--verb.ex: The train slowed before the bridge.

laughter--noun.ex: Laughter came from the next room.

push--noun.def: The act of pressing something away from you.
push--noun.ex: The door opened with one push.

board--verb.def: To get on a plane, a ship or a train.

grab--verb.def: To take hold of something quickly and roughly.
grab--verb.ex: He grabbed his bag and ran.
